clips.title: Full matrix colour changes
clips.description: The physical matrix changes from red to blue.

clips.title: Building a face pattern
clips.description: Red groups of cells build into a face on the dark matrix. The controlling software is off camera.

clips.title: Animated colour gradient
clips.description: A multicolour gradient moves across the illuminated pads.

clips.title: Centre-outward patterns
clips.description: Changing colour bands form around the centre of the matrix.

clips.title: Moving light patterns
clips.description: Individual bright areas and horizontal bands move across the dark matrix.

clips.title: Hands-on pad response
clips.description: Both hands press pads while multicolour patterns spread across the matrix.

clips.title: Pad presses and bright flashes
clips.description: Visible pad presses accompany bright whole-matrix flashes and colour changes.

clips.title: Colour pattern to individual cells
clips.description: An animated colour pattern gives way to a red matrix with selected blue cells.
